description: Return a list of all equipment makes.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique identifier of this equipment make.

name.description: Display name of the equipment make (manufacturer brand), unique within the company.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this equipment make.

is_active.description: Whether this equipment make is currently active. Inactive makes are hidden from selection lists but retained for historical records.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this record, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this record was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this make.

login.description: Email address (login) of the user who created this make.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this make.
